title: Top 10 municipalities by state received amount
human_request: Which city in Israel has the highest budget?
notes: Uses entities_data.received_amount: money received from the state in the last three years through budgetary supports or procurement contracts. This is not the full municipal annual budget.
query: SELECT entity_name, received_amount, item_url FROM entities_data WHERE entity_kind = 'municipality' ORDER BY received_amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
